name: Conservative Early Ray Termination
definition: A scheme to skip the scan conversion of a cell c if the ray is already sufficiently opaque in front of it, using a lookup table (ERT-table) to avoid per-pixel overhead during scan conversion.
summary: Conservative Early Ray Termination is a volume rendering optimization that prunes cell processing using a subscreen-based lookup table, differing from standard methods by enabling parallel scan conversion without per-pixel overhead.
